dialogue.content: おはようございます。本日は、宜しくお願い致します。時間になりましたら始めさせていただきますね＾＾
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for your time today. We'll get started now that it's our scheduled time. ^^

dialogue.content: おはようございます。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はご相談にお越し下さり、ありがとうございます。はじめに、年齢、性別、ご相談内容を聞かせていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: こんにちは。中2 女子です。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm a girl in the 8th grade.

dialogue.content: 成績が悪くて怒られました。
dialogue.English: I got yelled at for my bad grades.

dialogue.content: 家に居たくないです。
dialogue.English: I don't want to be at home.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれて有難うね。成績が悪くて怒られたんだね。それは辛かったね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me. So you were yelled at for your bad grades. That must have been really tough.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう少し詳しく聞きたいんですが、家にいたくないほど怒られたのかな？
dialogue.English: I'd like to ask a bit more about that. Were you yelled at so much that you don't want to be at home?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それは辛かったね。言える範囲でいいんだけど、どんな怒られ方をしたのかな？
dialogue.English: I see, that must have been very difficult. If you're comfortable sharing, could you tell me how you were yelled at?

dialogue.content: 昨夜2時間くらいずっと怒られて、、
dialogue.English: I was yelled at for about two hours straight last night...

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ
dialogue.English: Yes, go on.

dialogue.content: 夏休みは1日中塾に行くよう言われました。
dialogue.English: And I was told to go to cram school all day during summer vacation.

dialogue.content: なるほど、2時間もテストの事で怒られたのですね。それは、辛かったですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you were yelled at about your grades for two whole hours. That must have been very hard on you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 夏休みも１日中塾へ行くように言われたんだね。折角の夏休みだし勉強も大切だけど一日中は、大変だよね。
dialogue.English: And you were told to go to cram school all day during your summer break. It's summer break after all, and while studying is important, being there all day sounds really tough, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、友達とも遊ぶ約束してるのに、それもダメって言われて、、
dialogue.English: Yes, and I've already made plans to hang out with my friends, but I was told I can't do that either...

dialogue.content: 友達と遊ぶのもダメなんだ。それは、辛いよね。
dialogue.English: You're not allowed to hang out with your friends either. That must be upsetting.

dialogue.content: 友達に今更断れないです。
dialogue.English: I can’t cancel on my friends at this point.

dialogue.content: そうだよね。断り辛いよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It's hard to cancel on them, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こんな家居たくないです
dialogue.English: I don't want to be in a home like this.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんも楽しみにしていたでしょうに残念だよね。家にもいたくなくなる位悲しかったんだよね。
dialogue.English: You must have been looking forward to it, so it’s really disappointing. It must have made you so upset that you don’t even want to be at home.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 少し、詳しく聞いて行きたいんだけどご家族は誰と住んでるのかな？
dialogue.English: I'd like to ask a bit more, if that's okay. Who do you live with?

dialogue.content: 両親と弟です。
dialogue.English: My parents and my younger brother.

dialogue.content: ありがとうね。ご両親と弟さんなんだね。昨夜２時間も怒られたと言っていたんだけど、結構勉強には今までも厳しかったのかな？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So, your parents and your younger brother. You mentioned you were yelled at for two hours last night; have they always been strict about your studies?

dialogue.content: はい。私はいつでも成績悪いから。
dialogue.English: Yes. Because my grades are always bad.

dialogue.content: そう思っているんだね。いつも怒られているのは辛いよね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel. It must be hard being yelled at all the time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 因みにお父さん、お母さんどちらに怒られるのかな？
dialogue.English: By the way, is it your dad or your mom who yells at you?

dialogue.content: お母さんです
dialogue.English: It's my mom.

dialogue.content: お母さんに怒られるんだね。そっか、辛いよね。お母さんは相談者さんに成績を良くしてもらってどうなって欲しいとか話てくれるのかな？
dialogue.English: So it's your mom who yells at you. I see, that's tough. Has she ever talked about what she hopes for you if your grades improve?

dialogue.content: 大学に行けって言われています。
dialogue.English: She tells me to go to college.

dialogue.content: 大学進行けと言われるんだね。相談者さんは大学には行きたいのかな？
dialogue.English: She tells you to go to college. Do you want to go to college?

dialogue.content: あんま行きたくない。勉強は好きじゃないし。
dialogue.English: Not really. I don't like studying.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。行きたくないのに行けと言われても勉強も好きになれないし、頑張れないないよね。
dialogue.English: I see. Being told to go when you don’t want to won’t make you like studying, and it’s hard to stay motivated, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: だよね
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 因みに何をしてる時が一番楽しいのかな？
dialogue.English: By the way, what do you enjoy doing the most?

dialogue.content: 友達と話したり、遊んでいる時です。
dialogue.English: When I'm talking with or hanging out with my friends.

dialogue.content: 友達と話したり、遊んでる時なんだね。いいね＾＾
dialogue.English: So, when you're talking and hanging out with your friends. That's nice. ^^

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その中で時間を忘れて没頭できる物は何かあるかな？
dialogue.English: Is there anything you do with them that you get so absorbed in you lose track of time?

dialogue.content: 友達いると時間忘れる事あります。
dialogue.English: I sometimes lose track of time when I'm with my friends.

dialogue.content: 帰るのが遅くなってまた怒られるけど笑
dialogue.English: I end up getting home late and getting yelled at again, though. lol

dialogue.content: 友達といる時が時間忘れる時なんだね＾＾そうだよね。中二の女の子だもんね。ずっと話てたり、遊んだりしていたいよね。
dialogue.English: So you lose track of time when you're with your friends. ^^ That makes sense. You're an 8th-grade girl, after all. You just want to talk and hang out all the time, right?

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: だよね。
dialogue.English: I get it.

dialogue.content: 少し話を戻すんだけど良いかな？
dialogue.English: Can we go back a little, if that's alright?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今日は成績が悪くて怒られて、家に居たくないほど辛いいんだよね。大好きな友達とも会えなくなっちゃうし、、、
dialogue.English: So today, you were yelled at for your bad grades, and it's so upsetting that you don't want to be at home. And on top of that, you can't even see your friends, whom you love...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 辛いんだよね。の間違いです誤字すみません。
dialogue.English: I meant to say that it’s painful for you—sorry for the typo.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: It's okay.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんはこれから、どうしたいと思っているのかな？
dialogue.English: What would you like to do from now on?

dialogue.content: 夏休み中、塾に行くだけというのが嫌なので、
dialogue.English: I really don’t like the idea of spending summer vacation just going to cram school, so...

dialogue.content: やめて欲しい
dialogue.English: I want her to stop.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ聞いているので続けてね何をやめて欲しいか教えてもらっても良いかな？
dialogue.English: Yes, yes, I'm listening, so please continue. Could you tell me what you want her to stop?

dialogue.content: 塾に行かせるのをやめて欲しいです。
dialogue.English: I want her to stop making me go to cram school.

dialogue.content: なるほど、塾に行きたくないんだね。そうだよね、塾に行くとお友達と遊べないもんね。それは、辛いよね。。。
dialogue.English: I see, so you don't want to go to cram school. That makes sense, because if you go to cram school, you can't hang out with your friends. That must be tough...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: じゃあ、今日は、どうしたら、塾に行かなくて済むか一緒に考えよう！と言うのはどうですか？
dialogue.English: Then how about today, we think together about how you might be able to avoid going to cram school?

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: お願いします🙇‍♀️
dialogue.English: Yes, please. 🙇‍♀️

dialogue.content: ありがとね＾＾私は、相談者さんのご家族のことはわからないから、教えて欲しいんだけど、お母さんは何でそんなに、大学に行かせたいんだろうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. ^^ I don't know your family, so I'd like you to tell me, why do you think your mother wants you to go to college so badly?

dialogue.content: 就職？の為って言ってました。
dialogue.English: She said it’s for getting a job?

dialogue.content: 良い仕事に就けないって。
dialogue.English: That I won't be able to get a good job.

dialogue.content: なるほど、就職の為に大学に行かせたいんだね。と言うことは相談者さんの事を思って強く怒ってしまってるのかな？どう思う？
dialogue.English: I see, so she wants you to go to college for your future career. Do you think she might be yelling at you so harshly because she's thinking about you?

dialogue.content: そうかも…
dialogue.English: Maybe...

dialogue.content: なるほど、、、でも、塾には行きたくないもんね笑
dialogue.English: I see... But you still don't want to go to cram school, right? Lol.

dialogue.content: はい…笑
dialogue.English: Yes... lol.

dialogue.content: 勉強だけが人生じゃない！から笑就職の事なら、相談者さんは何か将来やりたい仕事とか、今好きな事とかはないのかな？
dialogue.English: Studying isn't everything in life! Lol. If it's about getting a job, is there any work you'd like to do in the future, or anything you're passionate about now?

dialogue.content: 将来の事はまだあまり考えていません。好きな事も今は特に無いです。
dialogue.English: I haven't really thought about the future yet. And I don't have anything I'm particularly passionate about right now.

dialogue.content: 声優は憧れます。
dialogue.English: I do admire voice actors.

dialogue.content: いいね！！
dialogue.English: That's great!!

dialogue.content: いいですかね！
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: 声優いいね！
dialogue.English: Being a voice actor sounds great!

dialogue.content: でも希望者は多いし、無理だと思っています。
dialogue.English: But a lot of people want to do it, so I think it's impossible for me.

dialogue.content: お母さんにもそう言われました。
dialogue.English: My mom told me that too.

dialogue.content: 無理だと思っているんだね。お母さんにもそう言われたら凹むよね。。でも、やってみないと分からないし絶対挑戦するべきだと思うよ！それなら頑張れそうじゃない？どうかな？
dialogue.English: So you think it's impossible. It's discouraging when your mom says that too, isn't it? But you never know until you try, and I think you should definitely give it a shot! Doesn't that sound like something you could work hard for? What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうかも…お母さんはもっと安定した仕事を選びなさいって言いましたが。
dialogue.English: Maybe... but my mom told me to choose a more stable job.

dialogue.content: でも頑張ってみます。
dialogue.English: But I'll try my best.

dialogue.content: 本日は、有難うございます＾＾お時間になりましたのでこちらで終えせていただこうと思います。声優に興味があると言う事で最後は相談者さんの好きな物への情熱が人生を開いていくと良いなと感じました。次回は、もう少しお話しを聞いてお母さんに対して伝える作戦を一緒に立てたいと思いましたがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for today. ^^ Our time is up, so we'll have to end here. Hearing about your interest in voice acting, I felt that your passion for something you love could really open up your life. Next time, I'd like to hear a bit more and help you come up with a plan to talk to your mother. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 話せてよかったです。
dialogue.English: I'm glad I could talk to you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。私も話せてよかったです＾＾お手数をおかけしてしまいますが、率直なFBを頂けると幸いです。また機会がありましたら、どうぞよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. I'm glad we could talk too. ^^ I know it's an extra step, but I would appreciate it if you could provide some honest feedback. I hope to speak with you again if the opportunity arises.
